ready.description: The one machine fact: fab.ready, all gates passed, exam passed.

summary.description: One line for the pane header.

kind.description: Open set; never switched on by Harness.

ref.description: What it is about: a part, a gate, a file.

artifact.description: Workspace-relative path of the primary thing to view.

phases.description: Where the work is, for the pane header's phase strip: the phases in order, each with a state. Optional; a harness with one phase writes none.

artifact.description: Workspace-relative path of what this phase produced, when it has one.

evaluation.description: How ready was decided, strongest method first: what judged the output, whether it passed, and whether ready depends on it. Optional; absent means the harness does not say.

method.description: tool: the domain's own verifier (a compiler, validator, simulator). checks: the request's measurable claims, measured on the output. review: a fresh-context model or a person graded it against a rubric. none: nothing trustworthy verifies this domain; the person is the judge.

by.description: What judged it: "LilyPond 2.24.4", "brief: key, 16 bars", "engraving rubric".

passed.description: Null while it has not run, and always for none.

gate.description: True when ready depends on it: ready is true only if every gate passed.

detail.description: One line: what it measured, or why it failed.
